purpose: Fresh V4 focused-grid 124M R1 comparison of independently implemented MALT and MALTER-Eq17 with frozen R1 controls

provenance.paper: MALT: Lightweight Curvature-Aware Muon via Diagonal Preconditioning

paper_ambiguities.malter_learning_rate: Algorithm 2 prints eta inside alpha and multiplies by eta again; Equation (17) and prose define alpha without eta
paper_ambiguities.malter_resolution: Use Equation (17), exactly one outer eta, and label the arm MALTER-Eq17-R1 adaptation

pilot_amendment.protocol_revision: historical v2 post-v1-upper-boundary extension retained inside v3
pilot_amendment.trigger_scope: partial-v1 observation containing the six completed MALT cells; no complete v1 aggregate selection certificate was claimed
pilot_amendment.trigger: The raw MALT step-1000 optimum among the original paper-grid cells was the frozen upper endpoint 0.0032
pilot_amendment.nonfinite_policy: Any non-finite or otherwise invalid pilot cell remains a failed hard gate and blocks formal selection; no infinite-loss imputation is allowed

formal_scope_amendment.trigger_evidence: The complete accepted v1 pilot found an internal MALTER-Eq17 endpoint optimum at lr=0.015 while the MALT optimum remained at its then-upper boundary 0.0032
formal_scope_amendment.decision: Rerun the complete 16-cell pilot under one fresh source/runtime/init lineage, select MALT and MALTER-Eq17 independently, and run three formal seeds for both methods
formal_scope_amendment.claim_boundary: MALTER formal evidence applies only to the Equation-(17), single-outer-eta R1 adaptation and is not an official MALTER reproduction

v4_focused_grid_amendment.protocol_revision: v4 fresh focused MALT upper-grid rerun with dual-method formal confirmation
v4_focused_grid_amendment.trigger_evidence: The complete accepted V3 pilot had MALT lr=0.0080 as the unique upper-boundary step-1000 optimum (3.7759 versus 3.7907 at lr=0.0064), while MALTER-Eq17 had the internal optimum lr=0.0150
v4_focused_grid_amendment.decision: Start one fresh V4 lineage; discard the already dominated lower MALT grid, retain lr=0.0064 and lr=0.0080 as lower anchors, add lr=0.0090, 0.0100, 0.0125, and 0.0160, rerun the original six-point MALTER-Eq17 grid, and select each method independently
v4_focused_grid_amendment.nonfinite_policy: Any non-finite or otherwise invalid pilot cell remains a failed hard gate and blocks formal selection; no infinite-loss imputation is allowed

r1_environment.train_shard_selection: exactly fineweb_train_000001.bin through fineweb_train_000050.bin in lexical/index order
r1_environment.data_content_gate: full SHA-256 and byte-size inventory is frozen before preflight and rehashed before every suite stage; later Experiment-48 shards are ignored
r1_environment.auxiliary_route: tied embedding/lm_head fused AdamW, lr=0.0036, betas=(0.9,0.95), weight_decay=0

optimizer.weight_decay_order: decoupled W *= (1 - lr_t * wd) before additive Algorithm-1 update
optimizer.statistics: per-optimizer-step row/column sums of squared final accumulated raw gradients
optimizer.orthogonalization: pinned R1 Newton-Schulz backend, 5 iterations; an R1 adaptation choice rather than a disclosed MALT setting
optimizer.packed_qkv: split Q/K/V into three independent logical matrices

pilot.boundary_tie_policy: any frozen boundary cell tied at the recorded minimum blocks formal

malt.selection_policy: Rank by recorded step-1000 endpoint loss, then lower matrix LR, then cell ID; select the first non-boundary result with no legacy paper-center preference because the paper center is outside the focused V4 grid
malt.boundary_rule: Validation loss is reported to four decimals; if either endpoint 0.0064 or 0.016 is among the cells tied at the recorded minimum, block formal and require a separately frozen directional grid amendment

malter_eq17.selection_policy: Prefer the paper center only when its recorded endpoint is within 0.002 of the raw endpoint best
malter_eq17.role: independently selected supporting formal baseline under the Equation-(17), single-eta interpretation
malter_eq17.boundary_rule: Validation loss is reported to four decimals; if either endpoint 0.007 or 0.025 is among the cells tied at the recorded minimum, block the complete dual-method formal panel and require a separately frozen directional grid amendment

pilot.method_coverage: 6 focused MALT formal-candidate cells plus 6 MALTER-Eq17 formal-candidate cells
pilot.panel_gate: Both methods must obtain an internal, analyzer-certified selection; either boundary result blocks the complete formal panel

formal.resume_policy: reuse locally accepted units and retry upload; incomplete training starts a new attempt

may_claim: controlled performance of a paper-derived MALT-R1 adaptation after all formal gates pass
controlled performance of a paper-derived MALTER-Eq17 single-eta R1 adaptation after all formal gates pass
state and quality comparisons inside the frozen R1 environment
must_not_claim: official MALTER reproduction or equivalence to the paper authors' undisclosed implementation
paper-grade wall-clock speedup from concurrent quality runs
cross-paper comparison of absolute validation loss
